title: Amazon Web Services STS temporary access key: must be flagged
summary: Synthetic Amazon Web Services STS temporary access key values built to the documented format appear in 12 inputs across 8 carrier types. Each input records the exact byte range of the secret.
rationale: A credential that a scanner misses in an ordinary carrier is leaked. Carriers differ in quoting, delimiters and surrounding text, so a hit on one carrier does not show coverage of another.

expectation.rationale: Standalone STS temporary access key ID: AWS documents ASIA IDs as unique only in combination with the secret access key and the session token, so a bare ID is redacted by project policy, not as a standalone credential.
